goal: Implement deterministic runtime-generation attestation, fail-closed controller enrollment, focused evidence, and an approval-gated upstream tracking issue.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Closed manifest and evidence contracts provide deterministic I-JSON and RFC 8785 identity with separate assurance appraisal.
The recorder binds only at session creation and keeps checkpoints, malformed sources, replacements, and transition-spanning sessions ineligible.
Controller enrollment verifies checked repository evidence and manifests, rejects duplicate sessions and invalid assurance, and preserves historical 1.0 snapshots without implicit attestation.
The focused proof and repository-wide verification gate pass.
The exact upstream tracking issue is published only after verification of a matching unexpired send_data_externally approval.

outcome.summary: Implementation and local verification completed, but the prepared GitHub tracking issue was not published because no exact external-transfer approval exists.

exception.reason: GitHub issue publication requires a separate approved, unexpired send_data_externally decision bound to the exact prepared payload scope.
exception.next_action: Review the prepared issue request, provide a matching approval decision, verify it at publication time, and then publish the unchanged payload.

what_worked: The runtime identity and appraisal contracts remain separate and fail closed.
Descriptor-backed repository reads removed the evidence check-and-reopen race and reject unsupported safe-open platforms.
Controller policy and state 1.0 snapshots remain valid while new estimates require version 1.1 runtime policy.
what_failed: Pinned DSH does not produce authoritative runtime-generation evidence or await asynchronous disposal listeners.
The external GitHub publication remained gated because no matching approval decision was supplied.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Run focused runtime-generation, recorder, controller, and provenance regression tests.

calls.name: code-review
calls.purpose: Audit schema compatibility, session lifecycle assumptions, and repository evidence loading.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run typecheck, build, complete tests, capsule validation, policy verification, and deterministic evaluations.

calls.name: issue-payload-digest
calls.purpose: Bind the exact local issue payload and required external-transfer approval scope without publishing it.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Current DSH lacks the authoritative producer and awaited final teardown seam required for end-to-end attestation availability.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Implement and validate the launcher/Loader producer and awaited teardown contract described by the prepared tracking issue.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: A sensitive external publication cannot proceed without an exact current human decision.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Provide a schema-valid approval decision matching the prepared scope, then verify it immediately before publication.

evidence.summary: The focused suite passed 27 tests; five opt-in integration tests were skipped.
The full gate passed typecheck, build, 206 tests with six opt-in skips, capsule validation, policy checking, and both deterministic evaluations.
The final automated audit found no remaining production-code defect; unsupported no-follow platforms and DSH disposal availability are fail-closed or explicitly bounded.
The focused contract records the implemented boundary, compatibility rule, safety checks, and pinned upstream limitations.
The local request binds the unchanged public issue payload to its destination, purpose, and required approval scope.
Governance requires exact send_data_externally approval before publishing the prepared issue, and no matching decision is available.

notes: Implementation review is not sensitive-action approval.
External issue publication remains pending a separate exact decision.
